## Use Overpass Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Overpass Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Overpass Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Overpass Mono coding font

An open-source font project by Red Hat. Overpass Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Overpass Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Overpass Mono FAQ

### Is Overpass Mono free?

Yes. Overpass Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Overpass Mono support ligatures?

No. Overpass Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Overpass Mono?

Overpass Mono is available from Google Fonts and GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
